The scores for these paths are consistent, indicating a plausible mechanistic link. The shared target of these compounds at the dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase level suggests a common pathway or mechanism of action. The presence of multiple compounds targeting the same kinase implies that the interaction may be modulated by different molecular pathways, potentially offering diverse therapeutic strategies. The integration of these findings supports the hypothesis that Npc115753 may act through this kinase pathway to influence ZR-75-1, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact mechanism and functional role.
